verdict.rationale: Graph view is a documented core plugin that visualizes note relationships built from internal links, and Obsidian's linking system explicitly creates a 'network of knowledge' that the graph renders; Graph view also supports filters (though filtering specifics aren't detailed in this pack). Community evidence confirms users actively rely on the linking/graph model for organizing knowledge (e.g., RPG notes, dev notes). Missing for 10: no evidence of advanced graph filtering UI details (tags/colors/query filters) or independent hands-on praise/critique specifically of graph view's filtering usability.
